title: Al-Muwasat Association Joins Assistive Technology Course in Jordan
summary: The Al-Muwasat Association participated in a course on assistive technologies held in Jordan, focusing on tools and devices designed to support individuals with disabilities.
body:
The Al-Muwasat Association participated in a course on assistive technologies held in Jordan, focusing on tools and devices designed to support individuals with disabilities.
